title: Ritos y tradiciones de Huarochirí (Taylor 1987) — Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendajú
notes: The collection is the single-text digitisation of Gerald Taylor's 1987 IEP/IFEA edition of the Huarochiri manuscript (Quechua, ca. 1608), held on the Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendaju at etnolinguistica.org (PDF verified live: https://etnolinguistica.wdfiles.com/local--files/biblio%3Ataylor-1987-ritos/TaylorG_1987_RitosYTradicionesDeHuarochiri.pdf). RQ has only the reconstituted quechua text as plain text-derived 'keyed' material. Publicly downloadable; not a TEI project. Origin verbatim: Taylor (ed.) 1987 via Biblioteca Digital Curt Nimuendaju / etnolinguistica.org. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (in-core, including retained duplicates; harvested subset).
